note: *desonrados … desonra* for *reveréri*: three gate Latinist minors say it names disgrace where the Latin names abashment. A third shame word beside *envergonhar* and *corar* (HANDOFF 17); *vexados* was unknown to the blind reader.
*o carente*: *indigente* failed four blind readers, so D38 took *carente* here. The Ps 36 agent proposes *desvalido*, which one reader did not know. One word to pick (HANDOFF 17).
*puseram-me à prova*, taken for the blind reader over *tentaram-me*. *tentáre* is now rendered three ways across the psalter (HANDOFF 17).
